title: Nasty Liq Peach Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Nasty Juice
description: Nasty Liq's Peach Ice is a harmonious creation that blends the full-bodied sweetness of sun-ripened peaches with the exhilarating touch of ice, reminiscent of a chilled peach sorbet on a warm day. Each inhale is a dive into the juicy heart of a peach, a flavour so ripe and sweet you can almost feel the fuzz against your skin. It's a taste that's immediately comforting, familiar yet thrilling in its authenticity. Then, as the warmth of the peach flavour lingers, a surprising chill of ice sweeps in. It's not jarring, but rather a refreshing shift that cleanses the palate, much like a gentle breeze that cools the air just as the afternoon heat peaks. This subtle coolness doesn't steal the show but supports the main act, ensuring the vibrant peach sings with clarity and remains the star of the show. This exquisite blend, housed in a convenient 10ml bottle, is perfect for those seeking a balanced vape. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth draw, making Peach Ice an ideal choice for both new and experienced vapers who desire a satisfying throat hit without any harshness. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the Nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Nasty Liq flavours to try. Nasty Juice have fine-tuned their vape juices for optimised performance with the vast majority of MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. They feature exceptional flavours and flavour blends across fruits, sweets, desserts and tobacco and many are also available in Nasty Juice’s super-convenient Nasty Bar disposable vape bars.
